snippet.title: Angeline Era- Official Release Window Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
An unforgettable and wild Bumpslash Action-Adventure! Explore a world of Fae, Humans and Angels, where hilarious hazards and charming creatures await. Will you uncover its mysteries?
Angelina Era is set to be released in Q4 2025. Visit Steam to add the game to your wishlist and download the demo!
